Definition: adverb from G4055; more superabundantly:--more abundant(-ly), X the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much more, the rather.
BiblicalUsage: Perissoteros means more abundantly, more earnestly. Paul says he endeavoured the more abundantly to see the Thessalonians' face, and his rejoicing was that he had his conversation in the world, and more abundantly toward them, in the grace of God.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Paul's “more abundantly” is the measure of a pastor's heart: he longed to see them, and his life among them was grace.
